# Faith Driven Singapore

> Faith Driven Singapore is the Singapore chapter of the global Faith Driven Entrepreneur (FDE) movement — a community of 200+ Christ-following founders and business builders who meet monthly, free of charge, to worship, learn from founders' stories and work through the FDE Foundation Course together.

## Key facts

- Name: Faith Driven Singapore (the Singapore chapter of the global Faith Driven Entrepreneur movement, FDE)
- Founded: first Foundations session on 14 August 2024 at BLOCK71 Singapore
- Founder: Prof. Aleks Farseev (founder & CEO of SOMIN; APAC / Southeast Asia Ambassador, Faith Driven Entrepreneur). Co-builders: Aidan Chan and Yuh Tyng Hsiao
- Origin: Faith Driven Entrepreneur co-founder Henry Kaestner challenged Aleks Farseev at the FDE global conference to plant a chapter in Singapore
- Size: 200+ members; 3 cohorts; 22 recorded Foundations sessions (Aug 2024 – Aug 2026); 7 venues (BLOCK71, Suntec, Browzwear, Marina One Residence, Kampung Siglap, Father's House, YMCA)
- Groups seeded: Taipei (first overseas group); London and Kenya forming
- Cost: free — "No cost. No catch."
- Cadence: monthly, usually Wednesday evenings
- Languages: English, 中文 (/zh/), Bahasa Melayu (/ms/), தமிழ் (/ta/)
- Contact: WhatsApp +65 9122 7009 · https://wa.me/6591227009
- Research: 776 coded live sharings from 22 sessions; top participant themes: calling & vocation (187 of 550), Spirit guidance & prayer (127), wealth & stewardship (110), identity & success (105); prosperity only 19

## Pages

- [Home](https://faithdriven.sg/): Faith Driven Singapore is the Singapore chapter of the global Faith Driven Entrepreneur movement: 200+ Christ-following founders, free monthly gatherings and Foundations Groups since 2024. No cost. No catch.
- [One invitation. One yes. A movement in Singapore.](https://faithdriven.sg/our-story/): How Faith Driven Singapore started: Aleks Farseev met Faith Driven Entrepreneur co-founder Henry Kaestner, took up his challenge to plant a Singapore chapter, and built a community of 200+ Christ-following founders since August 2024.
- [What Singapore's builders say when they talk about their calling.](https://faithdriven.sg/voices/): Insights and quotes from 22 recorded Faith Driven Singapore Foundations sessions (2024–2026) — 776 coded sharings on calling, discernment, burnout, money, Sabbath and faith in a multi-faith city.
- [Twenty-two sessions. Seven venues. One community.](https://faithdriven.sg/gatherings/): Every Faith Driven Singapore Foundations session since August 2024: dates, venues and recordings across three cohorts, plus how a Foundations Group works and how to join the next gathering.
- [Articles](https://faithdriven.sg/articles/): Guides and stories from Faith Driven Singapore: what Faith Driven Entrepreneur is, our founding story, redemptive marketing, Asian FDE stories like Grab and the New Taipei Kings, and insights from 22 Singapore sessions.

## Articles

- [What Is Faith Driven Entrepreneur (FDE)? A Guide for Singapore Founders](https://faithdriven.sg/articles/what-is-faith-driven-entrepreneur/): Faith Driven Entrepreneur (FDE) is a global movement helping Christ-following entrepreneurs find community and their God-given call to create. What it is, who started it, what it offers, and how to join in Singapore.
- [How Faith Driven Singapore Began: Henry Kaestner's Invitation and a Founder's Yes](https://faithdriven.sg/articles/faith-driven-singapore-founding-story/): The founding story of Faith Driven Singapore — how Aleks Farseev met Faith Driven Entrepreneur co-founder Henry Kaestner, was challenged to plant a chapter, searched for the right co-founders, and built a 200+ member community from August 2024.
- [A Child's Prayer for Ducks and the Faith Behind an AI Start-up: Aleks Farseev's Story](https://faithdriven.sg/articles/aleks-farseev-prayer-for-ducks/): Salt&Light's profile of Aleks Farseev, founder of SOMIN and Faith Driven Singapore: a boyhood prayer for ducks, The Screwtape Letters on a flight into conscription risk, a war that cut the business in half, and why he wants to "redeem the advertising world".
- [What Is Redemptive Marketing? Transparency, Trust and Faith in Digital Advertising](https://faithdriven.sg/articles/redemptive-marketing/): Redemptive marketing applies redemptive entrepreneurship to advertising: measure what matters to the client, tell the truth about results, sometimes sacrifice margin for a partner's good, and use AI to end the pressure to fabricate. Based on Aleks Farseev's Forbes article.
- [Faith Driven Entrepreneurs in Asia: Grab, Endowus, New Taipei Kings, Human Nature and More](https://faithdriven.sg/articles/faith-driven-entrepreneurs-in-asia/): A guide to Asian Faith Driven Entrepreneur stories and where to watch them — Anthony Tan (Grab), Samuel Rhee (Endowus), Phil Chen (New Taipei Kings), Dylan Wilk (Human Nature), Jeremy Lin — plus FDE Asia, and groups in Singapore, Taipei and Hong Kong.
- [Anthony Tan and Grab: A Faith Driven Entrepreneur Story from Southeast Asia](https://faithdriven.sg/articles/anthony-tan-grab-faith-driven-entrepreneur/): How Grab co-founder Anthony Tan's faith shapes the "super app" — the taxi-safety origin, the 4Hs, Matthew 25:40, and how Grab moved 150,000+ drivers into delivery in COVID. From Faith Driven Entrepreneur's "Excellence Matters" and podcast episode 131.
- ["No Out of Bounds": Phil Chen, the New Taipei Kings and Faith in Asian Sport](https://faithdriven.sg/articles/phil-chen-new-taipei-kings/): Phil Chen — former Silicon Valley VC, ordained pastor, CEO of Cold Electric and owner of Taiwan's New Taipei Kings — on identity in Christ, "your attention is your worship", and building a championship team. From Faith Driven Entrepreneur's film and podcast episode 291.
- [The FDE Foundation Course: All 8 Sessions Explained (with Singapore Recordings)](https://faithdriven.sg/articles/foundation-course-8-sessions-explained/): A session-by-session guide to the free Faith Driven Entrepreneur Foundation Course — Our Call to Create, God Owns My Business, Don't Worship Work, Excellence Matters, Faithful vs. Willful, Ministry in Word, Ministry in Deed, Global Movement — with recordings from Singapore.
- [What 22 Sessions Taught Us: 7 Insights From Singapore's Faith-Driven Founders](https://faithdriven.sg/articles/what-singapore-founders-say/): Seven findings from 776 coded sharings across 22 Faith Driven Singapore Foundations sessions (2024–2026): discernment over prosperity, the unicorn myth, rewriting Asian success scripts, character-first witness in a multi-faith city, and a mobile community.
- [Don't Worship Work: Burnout, Hustle Culture and Sabbath for Asian Founders](https://faithdriven.sg/articles/dont-worship-work-burnout-sabbath/): Why so many founders burn out, what the FDE "Don't Worship Work" session teaches, and how Singapore's faith-driven entrepreneurs practise Sabbath — "not to rest from work, but to start working from rest".
